title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Start Date - 21/09/2026

Shift Pattern - We are offering 20 or 25 Hours, Part-Time Lates
Monday - Friday 16:45 PM to 21:00 PM (We would also be flexiable with an earlier finish at 20:00pm if needed)

20 Hours per Week - Salary: £13,928.53 per year
Plus incentives and bonus opportunities

25 Hours per Week - Salary: £17,410.67 per year
Plus incentives and bonus opportunities

With no weekend working and a schedule designed to fit around your life, this is a great opportunity to build a rewarding career while maintaining the work-life balance that matters most.

Looking for a role that works around family life, childcare, studies or other commitments? Our part-time evening shifts offer the flexibility to keep your days free while enjoying every weekend off.

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our Truro team's full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Truro contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths

Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.

It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.

People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £13,928.53 which goes up to £14,260.27 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: People & Culture Coordinator
description:
People & Culture Coordinator

Full Time, Permanent Liskeard Hybrid - 2 Days from Home £29,000 - £33,000 DOE

Well Placed HR is pleased to be working exclusively with a growing and forward-thinking organisation in Liskeard to recruit a People & Culture Coordinator - Recruitment & Governance.

This is a varied operational HR role, ideal for someone with experience in HR administration, recruitment coordination or People Operations who enjoys keeping things organised, working with systems and making sure processes run smoothly.

Working closely with the HR Business Partner, you'll play an important role across recruitment, onboarding, HR administration, payroll inputs, people systems and governance. You'll also have the opportunity to get involved in improving processes, automation and manager self-service.

What you'll be doing as People & Culture Coordinator
- Coordinating recruitment from vacancy approval through to offer and onboarding.
- Managing candidate communication, interview scheduling and recruitment records.
- Coordinating new starter administration, including right to work checks, contracts and HR system set-up.
- Maintaining accurate and confidential employee records and HR systems.
- Coordinating payroll inputs, including starters, leavers, contractual changes, absence, pensions and benefits.
- Supporting HR reporting, people metrics and governance checks.
- Monitoring the HR inbox and acting as a first point of contact for routine HR queries.
- Supporting employee lifecycle administration, including references, family leave, flexible working and Occupational Health referrals.
- Helping to improve HR processes, workflows, systems and manager self-service.
- Ensuring HR documentation is accurate, GDPR compliant and audit-ready.

What we're looking for
- Previous experience in HR administration, recruitment coordination, People Operations or a similar operational role.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Experience supporting recruitment and onboarding processes.
- Good IT skills and confidence working with HR systems and Microsoft Office.
- Experience with payroll administration or payroll inputs would be advantageous.
- A proactive and practical approach, with the ability to manage competing deadlines.
- Strong communication skills and the confidence to deal with managers, candidates and colleagues at all levels.
- CIPD Level 3 qualified, working towards it, or equivalent experience would be desirable.

This role would suit someone who enjoys HR operations, systems, data and process improvement rather than someone looking for a predominantly employee relations or HR advisory position.

What's on offer
- £29,000 - £33,000 depending on experience.
- Hybrid working - 2 days from home each week.
- Flexible working.
- Company pension.
- Attractive annual leave package.
- Enhanced sick and family leave.
- Bespoke training and development.
- Free onsite parking.
- Employee share options.
- Death in service benefit.
- Employee Assistance Programme.

If you're an organised HR professional who enjoys making things happen behind the scenes and wants to join a business where you can develop and make a genuine impact, we'd love to hear from you.

To apply, please send your CV to Carly Kellow, quoting reference CK11200
